changelog:
- Added noise suppression to Voice chat (on by default), like Discord's: removes keyboard clicks, fans and background noise
- New Media rank for content creators (requirements on the website)
- The Z tag in the overlay now shows each player's rank colour
- Rank changes now show up within an hour, no need to relink Discord
- Linking Discord is more reliable
- Zoomies is now free for everyone; nametag outlines and statuses are now rank perks
- Option to show or hide your cosmetics in first person, and cosmetics run faster
- Statuses no longer overlap Hypixel's lines above players' names
- Stickers are bigger by default (10 chat lines)
- Your free sticker and free sound can now be switched once a week
- Clicking a feature in the card menu now opens that feature directly
- Quests renamed to Quests Tracker
- Milk notifier fixed; Magic Milk, Out of arrows and Jump Boost can now also show as a title on screen
- Spectate: you see your spectators' cosmetics, and they can't spawn inside blocks after a world change anymore
- Spectate: spectators no longer get your tokens / XP / ticket messages or "Unknown command" spam
- Spectate: you're told how to chat with your spectators (/spec chat), and up to 12 people can watch at once
- Badlion: fixed the double nametag and the misaligned nametag outline
- Fixed bugs and improved performance
- & more!
